# FormKiQ Documentation

> FormKiQ is an API-first document management platform deployed in your AWS account. Feature availability depends on the edition, installed modules, and configuration.

## Getting started
- [Overview](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/overview): Platform capabilities and common use cases.
- [AWS Quick Start](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Deploy with CloudFormation.
- [Local Quick Start](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/getting-started/quick-start-local): Run a development instance with Docker Compose.
- [API walkthrough](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/getting-started/api-walkthrough): Authenticate and perform document operations.

## Development and operations
- [API reference](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/category/formkiq-api): Document, metadata, search, and administration APIs.
- [Platform architecture](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/category/platform): Storage, processing, hosting, and operational guidance.
- [Security and governance](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/category/security-governance): Access controls, residency, and regulated deployment planning.
- [SDKs and integration](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/category/sdk-api-integration): SDK and integration guidance.
- [Business Solutions](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/category/business-solutions): Web experiences including Contract Management.
- [Changelog](https://docs.formkiq.com/docs/category/changelog): Independent web and backend release notes and compatibility guidance.

Treat the API reference as release-specific. Verify feature availability and compatibility against the target deployment rather than assuming every optional capability is installed.
